speaker: Liora
text: Kai. Before the year ends and everything changes — I need to say a thing, and you need to not interrupt.

speaker: Liora
text: I've tended everyone's flame but my own since I was a girl. And then you noticed me back. Nobody ever... you NOTICED me back.

speaker: Liora
text: So. The thing is that I love you. That's the thing.

speaker: Kai
text: Say it again. Please. Nobody's ever — I want to hear it while I'm brave enough to answer.

speaker: Liora
text: I love you, Kai of nowhere and everywhere. Now say YOUR thing before I set something on fire.

speaker: Kai
text: I love you. There. The world's strangest magic, and it's the only one that's never scared me.

speaker: Kai
text: Liora... I can't. Not yet. Everything I am is still waking up — I won't hand you half a person.

speaker: Liora
text: ...then I'll wait by the fire, dolt. It's what I'm best at. But you OWE me a whole person, Kai. I'm collecting.

speaker: Liora
text: Now come on. Practice field. If tonight taught me anything, it's that your flame gets brighter around me.
